❓ Help

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I book a ticket?
Search for the desired location, click "Book Now", select citizen type and quantity, review payment details, click "Make Payment", and find your ticket in "My Bookings".
When will my boarding pass be available?
Your digital boarding pass is available immediately after successful payment. You can download it from the "My Bookings" section.
How do I cancel a booked ticket?
Go to "My Bookings", select the ticket you wish to cancel, and click the cancel button. Refunds are processed automatically as per the cancellation policy.
Do you accept international payment methods?
Yes, we accept international credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard) along with UPI and net banking for domestic payments.
What if payment is deducted but I didn't receive the ticket?
Please contact our helpdesk at helpdesk.tourist@rajasthan.gov.in or call 0141-2923486. Unprocessed payments are automatically refunded within 5-7 business days.
How can I submit a grievance?
Use the HelpDesk section on the portal to submit complaints, feedback, or grievances. Our team will respond within 48 hours.
